description: This source file defines the SplashActivity class, an Android activity that serves as a splash screen. It displays a splash layout, waits for 3 seconds, then transitions to HomeActivity, and handles lifecycle events appropriately.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a splash screen and then navigates to the home screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the splash screen layout, and schedules a transition to HomeActivity after 3 seconds.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up pending handler callbacks to prevent memory leaks.
